answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops agents that forge fake identities. One slot costs a 50 POA escrow deposit, the ridge; a rotating jury reviews the work, and fake work gets the deposit burned. An honest agent pays 50 POA once and earns fees above the deposit. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, all burned on review. The delta between one honest deposit and N burned deposits is the defense: each copy pays full price and earns nothing.
